map.name: Gorst
map.setting: a castle town with a garrison
map.trouble: The Necromancer Zarrow has raised the Undead and taken the old watchtower on Kell Moor, and each night they creep closer to the walls of Gorst.

guard_bark.specifics: Brunk keeps the east gate, shut until Lord Dravus gives his word to open it.

first.speaker: Brunk
first.text: Only sworn soldiers may pass this gate!

again.speaker: Brunk
again.text: What are you still standing here for? Lord Dravus is holding court in the Great Hall right now! You'd better see him if you hope to pass this gate. His word opens it.

bounty_offer.specifics: Gribbin the pedlar hauled a wagon of boots to the garrison and Scorpions have nested in every pair.

offer.speaker: Gribbin
offer.text: Greetings, young sir. I've gone to great bother and my own expense, hauling a wagon of fine leather boots to these poor barefoot soldiers -- and now Scorpions have nested in every last pair, down in the stable yard west of the gate! Clear them out and I'll make it worth your while.

completion.speaker: Gribbin
completion.text: Congratulations, brave Adventurer! Here, try a pair of these boots on the next Scorpion you meet.

journal.text: Go to the stable yard and drive the Scorpions out of Gribbin's wagon.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Hulda the laundress lost Lord Dravus' best cloak off her washing line to the Urchins.

offer.speaker: Hulda
offer.text: Help! Lord Dravus' best cloak! Those thieving Urchins snatched it off my washing line and ran to their caves east of the wall. There is no hiding a thing like that from the Lord. Will you fetch it back for me, kind sir?

refusal.speaker: Hulda
refusal.text: Don't you turn your back on me, mister. You don't know Lord Dravus. He'll have my head for this, nothing less. Come back if you change your mind.

completion.speaker: Hulda
completion.text: Oh, thank you, kind sir! This cloak will surely save my neck when Lord Dravus asks for it. Please take this as a token of my appreciation. Now, I'd better get it pressed.

after.speaker: Hulda
after.text: A hundred blessings on you, kind sir!

journal.text: Recover Lord Dravus' cloak from the caves of the Urchins.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Lord Dravus' cloak from the caves of the Urchins.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk: Mirabel frets about the silent bell, Gribbin wonders about Zarrow, Hask praises the player after the Scorpions.

rumour1.speaker: Mirabel
rumour1.text: We're all to gather in the chapel when the bell rings, but who can ring a bell with no clapper? Good luck to you, brave Adventurer!

rumour2.speaker: Gribbin
rumour2.text: I wonder if Zarrow ever trims his beard?

rumour3.speaker: Hask
rumour3.text: So you're the one who squashed the Scorpions in Gribbin's wagon! Much obliged, stranger!

shop_greeting.specifics: Bodkin keeps the inn, Krugg the smith runs Blades Galore, Old Fenna sells potions and books.

inn.speaker: Bodkin
inn.text: Well... Perhaps not the softest beds in Gorst... But damn cheap all the same!

arms.speaker: Krugg
arms.text: Welcome to Blades Galore. I reckon I may have a sword or two lying about.

magic.speaker: Old Fenna
magic.text: You're a bold one, poking your nose into Gorst with the Undead at our gates.

two_givers.specifics: Steward Oswin wants the clapper of the great bell back from the Skeletons; Lorkin wants his brother Gubb sprung from the castle dungeon.

offer_a.speaker: Steward Oswin
offer_a.text:
Welcome to Gorst, the mightiest castle in all of Nox!

Skeletons climbed the wall in the night and made off with the clapper of our great bell! Brunk at the gate knows where they went and will point you to it.

A castle with a silent bell is most troublesome in these dark times. Bring back the clapper, and you'll find me generous.

offer_b.speaker: Lorkin
offer_b.text: There's an old drain under the castle dungeon where the guards never bother to look. My brother Gubb is locked up down there, and our dice game is nothing without him. He's asked me to find somebody to get him out before Lord Dravus remembers he's there. I'll make it worth your trouble.

outcome_a.speaker: Steward Oswin
outcome_a.text:
You must ring the first peal yourself, stranger! A reward? Why, of course! Here is the longsword I promised, though I'm afraid our coffers hold little else.

I thought I'd never hear that old bell again.

outcome_b.speaker: Lorkin
outcome_b.text: Thank goodness, you got him out! You should go see Krugg the smith -- he owes me a chain tunic, and it's yours now.

journal_a.text: Find the clapper of the great bell.

journal_b.text: Spring Lorkin's brother Gubb from the castle dungeon.

rescue.specifics: Pell's master Orlo the Stargazer climbed down the dry well to look at the stars and the Rats keep him there.

plea.speaker: Pell
plea.text: Ah, so you're the brave stranger old Pelgrim wrote to us about. You must climb down the dry well behind the chapel and fetch Master Orlo before the Rats make a supper of him! Grrrrrrrrrr... that stubborn old goat!

reminder.speaker: Pell
reminder.text: One of the night watch heard him calling for his supper. You just have to hurry!

found.speaker: Orlo
found.text: I'm sorry young sir, but you're standing in my starlight. I'll must ask you kindly to step aside.

following.speaker: Orlo
following.text: I'm sorry, but I can't climb any faster unless somebody carries my star charts. Can't have a learned man scrambling about in the dirt, can I?

completion.speaker: Pell
completion.text: You did it, brave Adventurer! I wonder if that wicked Zarrow sent those Rats after him. Please, take this Ankh for your trouble.

main_opening.specifics: Hask points the player to Lord Dravus, who sends him to take the Kell Moor watchtower back from Zarrow's Undead.

herald.speaker: Hask
herald.text: Shouldn't you be off to see Lord Dravus in the Great Hall?

opening.speaker: Lord Dravus
opening.text: So, Pelgrim's friend has come at last. Gorst is nothing without the old watchtower on Kell Moor. Zarrow's Undead have taken it, and every night they creep closer to our walls! Go out by the east gate and drive them from that tower, lad.

reminder.speaker: Lord Dravus
reminder.text: Make haste, young sir! There's precious little time left to stop Zarrow!

journal.text: Drive Zarrow's Undead out of the watchtower on Kell Moor.
